name: Barrick Mining Corporation
summary: Established in 1983 and based in Toronto, Canada, Barrick Mining Corporation is engaged in the comprehensive lifecycle of mineral properties, covering their discovery, advancement, extraction, and eventual commercialization. The company's primary focus in its exploration endeavors includes gold, copper, silver, and various energy-related materials. Notably, the firm previously operated under the name Barrick Gold Corporation, transitioning to its current identity, Barrick Mining Corporation, in May 2025.
